title: Integrality and projectivity of an ordinary finite-type blowup
statement: Let $T$ be an integral scheme [def-pc-integral-scheme] and let $\mathcal I\subseteq\mathcal O_T$ be a nonzero quasi-coherent ideal of finite type, meaning that its restriction to every affine open corresponds to a finitely generated ideal [pqf-def-coherent]. Let $b:B=\operatorname{Bl}_{\mathcal I}(T)\to T$ be its ordinary blowup [def-nagata-global-blowup]. Then $B$ is integral and $b$ is projective in the projective-bundle sense [def-trf-projective-bundle-morphism].

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-integral-blowup-chart-density]. The domain charts cover $B$, so $B$ is reduced. The same lemma says that $U=T\setminus V(\mathcal I)$ is nonempty integral and that $b^{-1}(U)$ meets every nonempty chart in a dense open; hence $b^{-1}(U)$ is dense in $B$. By [thm-nagata-global-blowup-complement], this open is isomorphic to $U$, so is nonempty and irreducible. A space with a dense irreducible subspace is irreducible: two nonempty opens meet that subspace and then meet each other there. Thus $B$ is nonempty, reduced and irreducible, hence integral by [def-pc-integral-scheme].

source.place: Tag 02ND (lemma-blow-up-integral-scheme); assembly of returned Steps 1 and 2 using the chart-density lemma.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-blowup-rees-symmetric-presentation] to obtain the graded surjection $\operatorname{Sym}(\mathcal I)\twoheadrightarrow\mathcal R$ and the isomorphism $B\cong\operatorname{Proj}_T(\mathcal R)$ over $T$. Clause 3 of [prop-nagata-relative-proj-functoriality] turns that surjection into a closed immersion $\operatorname{Proj}_T(\mathcal R)\hookrightarrow\operatorname{Proj}_T(\operatorname{Sym}(\mathcal I))$ over $T$. Precompose with the isomorphism to obtain a closed immersion $B\hookrightarrow\mathbf P_T(\mathcal I)$ whose structural composite is $b$. The given quasi-coherence and finite type of $\mathcal I$ supply the module $\mathcal E=\mathcal I$ in [def-trf-projective-bundle-morphism], so $b$ is projective in that sense.
